## Research, overlap and planned public behavior

- Reader question: how can a cross-source Events timeline bar represent process lifetime, a paired model exchange, aggregated network observations or Tool timestamps, and when is its visual width not measured latency?
- Primary source: product master commit 9d33c5b, including ext/web/utils/eventSpans.ts, eventSpans.test.mjs, SessionEvents.tsx, SessionAnalysis.tsx. Regression tests cover open processes, overlapping model calls, native/captured duplicate display, tool timing and network status. UI minimum drawn width is 0.4% of total range; initial event table limit 300. A network endpoint with 40 observations and two errors remains success-colored because the failure criterion requires all observed counts to be errors.
- Semantic-overlap audit: existing trace-timestamps article owns epoch/SSE unit issues; network-target article owns aggregate count fields; process-exit article owns low-level outcome evidence; snapshot article owns exported schema. None answers the newly implemented UI bar reconstruction question. New canonical URL /blog/what-agentsight-event-timeline-bars-mean/ is distinct; article links to all adjacent owners and emphasizes master-versus-release boundary.
